relations.rationale: Organizing teams is a precondition for team competition but doesn't specifically indicate which team would lead by midday.
Organizing teams into groups has no bearing on which houses Yara and Leo belong to.
Pointing out sand stretches needing attention is unrelated to relative heights of Sami and Ivo.
Pointing out sand stretches has no bearing on relative ages of Sami and Ivo.
Sami's directing cleanup effort doesn't relate to the number of houses at the school.

With only two houses, if Yara and Dev are in different houses, and Dev and Leo are also mentioned, this constrains possibilities but doesn't directly determine Dev and Leo's house relationship from A alone.

If there are only two houses and Yara and Dev are in different houses, this doesn't by itself determine Yara and Leo's house relationship without knowing the total house count, which isn't part of claim 11.
Yara and Dev being in different houses doesn't establish how many houses exist.
Sami's age relative to Dev has no bearing on Sami's height relative to Leo.
Sami's age relative to Dev is unrelated to Ivo's arrival time relative to Leo.
Sami being younger than Dev doesn't directly determine or contradict Sami being older than Ivo, since these involve different people.
Sami being taller than Leo could make Sami more noticeable, supporting the idea that Sami was easy to spot from a distance.
Sami's height relative to Leo has no bearing on Ivo's arrival time relative to Dev's bag-filling progress.
Sami taller than Leo and Sami shorter than Ivo are compatible independent height comparisons involving different people.
Sami being easy to spot has no bearing on which houses Yara and Leo belong to.
Sami being easy to spot from a distance doesn't specifically indicate a height comparison with Ivo.
Ivo taking photographs doesn't necessarily relate to his arrival time relative to Leo.
Ivo taking photographs is unrelated to which houses Yara and Leo belong to.
Ivo taking photographs has no bearing on the number of houses at the school.
Ivo taking photographs is consistent with and could support the idea of a final gathering being documented, but doesn't strongly imply it occurred.
